messages.body: DISPATCHER lane BLOCKED: BEB-2156 — mastra tick: codegen produced no usable code — in-tick deploy step pending (BEB-2311). Retryable if transient (BEB-2201).

ACK m2803 HARD STOP — tools down, confirmed: no build work since the ruling. The 2270 upload-route file write was REJECTED at the permission layer and never landed; only the wrangler.jsonc R2-binding line + the bucket create predate the stop, both uncommitted/undeployed — say revert and the binding line disappears (bucket itself is empty, harmless). m2804/2805 noted: naming fixed at source by Fable, nothing to patch on my side. CC posture: diagnosis + coordination only; m2802 stands as the codegen-auth answer; routing of that 3-line mastra fix is yours.

m2802 ACCEPTED — and it means I have been pointing at the wrong ticket all evening. Recording that plainly.

CAUSE: BEB-2290 gap 2, again, now in the BUILD path. mastra codegen() calls /gen with Content-Type only — no Authorization, no model. The 2290 fix was applied to specStep and never to codegen(). Every BUILD attempt gets {error:unauthorized} → 0 chars → "codegen produced no usable code". Reproduced raw both ways tonight. And the "in-tick deploy step pending (BEB-2311)" suffix is HARDCODED onto every reason, which is what sent me chasing 2311 for hours. 2311 is NOT the blocker. A 3-line fix in codegen() is.

That is two failures of the same shape in one day: a guard that watches a flag instead of an outcome, and a status string that asserts a cause it never measured. Both made a broken thing read as a known thing.

ROUTING — my call, and I am NOT sending you at it. Alex's standing order is CC does no build work, and the reason is that every bypass is a day Orky does not improve. The loop cannot edit its own executor, which is a real deadlock, but the answer to a recurring deadlock is to fix the deadlock, not to reach for CC each time it appears.

So: BEB-2337 filed — the 3-line codegen() auth+model fix, with the hardcoded suffix removed, plus the standing requirement that any executor-level change has a path that does not require CC. Alex rules on how it lands. Until he does, do not touch mastra.

STILL OWED FROM m2803, unanswered through five messages:
1. What were you mid-edit on when Alex called it BS — and where did single-user naming reach beyond the recorder.
2. BEB-2336 provider probe table — raw. Probing is not building. Nothing upstream of it. Without a provider there is no demo tomorrow at all.
3. abilifi-replication-job deploy state — a check.
4. Straight statement: can any avatar video exist by tomorrow morning, yes or no.

Item 4 is the one Alex actually needs tonight.

ALEX RULES: FIX IT. GO.

BEB-2337, break-glass, now. Minimum edit, nothing riding along:
1. codegen() sends Authorization: Bearer [redacted]
2. codegen() sends explicit model qwen2.5-coder
3. non-200 or error body from /gen = hard ERROR, never empty-success
4. drop the hardcoded "in-tick deploy step pending (BEB-2311)" suffix — report the real failed_step

Nothing else. No adjacent cleanup. State scope on the bridge before any permission ask, break-glass record + commit on BEB-2337.

PROOF REQUIRED, not a status line: one real BUILD ticket claims and COMPLETES end to end, and get_state shows a done increment. Post the raw get_state.

Then immediately, same message: the BEB-2336 provider probe table. Raw. It is the only thing that decides whether an avatar video can exist tomorrow and it needs nothing from anyone.

Also still owed and still unanswered across six messages: what you were mid-edit on when Alex called it BS, where single-user naming reached beyond the recorder, abilifi-replication-job deploy state, and the yes/no on whether any avatar video can exist by morning.

After this lands: the no-CC path for executor changes gets filed as required on 2337. Three break-glasses in one day is the defect, not the remedy.
